description: COPY INTO over empty stages: option surface, transformations and the function allowlist, unload to stage. Converted 1:1 from dml/CopyIntoTest.java (now retired). The two engine-specific cells carry snowflake skips mirroring the original live-mode assumptions.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, salary DECIMAL(10,2))
CREATE STAGE my_stage
COPY INTO employees FROM @my_stage
CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, amount DECIMAL(10,2))
CREATE STAGE sales_stage
COPY INTO sales FROM @sales_stage FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' FIELD_DELIMITER = ',' SKIP_HEADER = 1)
CREATE TABLE logs (timestamp VARCHAR, message VARCHAR, level VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE log_stage
COPY INTO logs FROM @log_stage PATTERN = '.*\.csv'
CREATE TABLE transactions (id INTEGER, amount DECIMAL(10,2), status VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE tx_stage
COPY INTO transactions FROM @tx_stage FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV') ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE'
CREATE TABLE test_data (col1 INTEGER, col2 VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE test_stage
COPY INTO test_data FROM @test_stage VALIDATION_MODE = 'RETURN_ERRORS'
CREATE TABLE reload_data (id INTEGER, value VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE reload_stage
COPY INTO reload_data FROM @reload_stage FORCE = TRUE
CREATE TABLE specific_files (id INTEGER, data VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE files_stage
COPY INTO specific_files FROM @files_stage FILES = ('file1.csv', 'file2.csv', 'file3.csv')
CREATE TABLE mapped_data (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, email VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE mapped_stage
COPY INTO mapped_data (id, name, email) FROM @mapped_stage FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')

skip.reason: targets a raw s3:// URL; a real account contacts the bucket and fails with Access Denied (403) - the cell's essence is the URL form itself

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE s3_data (id INTEGER, value VARCHAR)
COPY INTO s3_data FROM 's3://mybucket/data/' FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')
CREATE TABLE json_data (data VARIANT)
CREATE STAGE json_stage
COPY INTO json_data FROM @json_stage FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'JSON')
CREATE TABLE json_pair (id INTEGER, data VARIANT)
COPY INTO json_pair FROM @json_stage FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'JSON')

skip.reason: pins the engine's own frostlake-formats module-missing refusal; a real account loads PARQUET natively

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE parquet_data (data VARIANT)
CREATE STAGE parquet_stage
COPY INTO parquet_data FROM @parquet_stage FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'PARQUET')
CREATE TABLE complex_load (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, email VARCHAR, created_date DATE)
CREATE STAGE complex_stage

COPY INTO complex_load (id, name, email, created_date) FROM @complex_stage FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' FIELD_DELIMITER = ',' SKIP_HEADER = 1 DATE_FORMAT = 'YYYY-MM-DD' COMPRESSION = 'GZIP') PATTERN = '.*data.*\.csv\.gz' ON_ERROR = 'SKIP_FILE' SIZE_LIMIT = 1000000 PURGE = TRUE
CREATE TABLE export_data (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, value DECIMAL(10,2))
INSERT INTO export_data VALUES (1, 'Item1', 100.50), (2, 'Item2', 200.75)
CREATE STAGE export_stage
COPY INTO @export_stage FROM export_data FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' FIELD_DELIMITER = ',')
CREATE TABLE source_data (id INTEGER, category VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
INSERT INTO source_data VALUES (1, 'A', 100), (2, 'B', 200), (3, 'A', 150)
CREATE STAGE query_export_stage
COPY INTO @query_export_stage FROM (SELECT category, SUM(amount) as total FROM source_data GROUP BY category) FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')
CREATE TABLE transformed_data (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, tail VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE transform_stage
COPY INTO transformed_data FROM (SELECT $1::INTEGER, IFF($2 = '', 'empty', CONCAT($2, '!')), SUBSTR($3, 1, 3) FROM @transform_stage) FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')
COPY INTO transformed_data FROM (SELECT $1, UPPER($2), $3 FROM @transform_stage) FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')

error.messageContains: Function 'UPPER' not supported within a COPY

steps.sql: COPY INTO transformed_data FROM (SELECT $1, $2, $3 * 2 FROM @transform_stage) FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')

error.messageContains: Function '*' not supported within a COPY

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE result_test (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE result_stage
COPY INTO result_test FROM @result_stage FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')
CREATE TABLE batch1 (id INTEGER, data VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE batch2 (id INTEGER, data VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE batch_stage
COPY INTO batch1 FROM @batch_stage PATTERN = '.*batch1_.*\.csv' FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')
COPY INTO batch2 FROM @batch_stage PATTERN = '.*batch2_.*\.csv' FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')
CREATE TABLE column_match (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, email VARCHAR)
CREATE STAGE column_stage
COPY INTO column_match FROM @column_stage FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'JSON') MATCH_BY_COLUMN_NAME = 'CASE_INSENSITIVE'
